newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re sees 20 to 25 pct premium growth.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re sees 20 to 25 pct premium growth.

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance Co said it expects net premiums to grow by 20 to 25 percent in 1997, based on current exchange rates.

Swiss Re said the premium growth would be based on both internal growth as well as consolidation of Mercantile and General Re, according to Swiss Re materials released ahead of the annual news conference.
"It is too early to forecast results for 1997," the Swiss presentation materials said.

Swiss Re said on May 2 in reporting its 1996 results that it expected 1997 results to benefit from a good start to the year, an improved balance sheet structure and wider consolidations after acquisitions last year.
Swiss Re's presentation materials for the news conference said major claims so far this year were at the same level as in early 1996.
"Investment results have been good so far," it said about 1997.

The main expansion in 1997 business consolidation will come from last year's purchase of Mercantile and General Re and Unione Italiana di Riassicurazione as well as a higher stake it plans to take this year in PartnerRe, Swiss Re added. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
